# PR-Agent Test Fixtures

All fixtures in this directory verify PR-Agent comment and state parsing only. None of these fixtures authenticate GitHub Actions workflow identity beyond the shared `github-actions` / `github-actions[bot]` login and comment markers.

| Fixture                          | Origin / Provenance                                                                              | Sanitization / Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pr-133.md`                      | Captured live PR-Agent comment from `gordonpn/merge-verdict` PR #133                             | Repository owner sanitized to `fixture-owner`; emojis stripped. Contains `<!-- pr-agent:review:full -->` without commit SHA header or state JSON.                                                                                                                    |
| `pr-134.md`                      | Captured live PR-Agent comment from `gordonpn/merge-verdict` PR #134                             | Repository owner sanitized to `fixture-owner`; emojis stripped. Contains repository-bound `Review updated until commit` header without state JSON.                                                                                                                   |
| `pr-154-multi-ticket.md`         | Captured live PR-Agent comment from `gordonpn/merge-verdict` PR #154 (`issuecomment-7073486825`) | Repository owner sanitized to `fixture-owner`; emojis stripped. Demonstrates multi-ticket `Ticket compliance analysis` for referenced epics `#74` and `#5` alongside `<!-- pr-agent-review-state:v1 -->` (`complete: false`, mixed `ACTIVE` and `RESOLVED` entries). |
| `state-comment.md`               | Synthetic template derived from captured `<!-- pr-agent-review-state:v1 -->` format              | Used with `state.json` to test state schema parsing and head SHA freshness.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `state.json`                     | Synthetic JSON payload derived from captured `<!-- pr-agent-review-state:v1 -->` schema          | Synthetic SHA `1111...` and finding metadata for deterministic tests.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `synthetic-ticket-boundaries.md` | Synthetic template for boundary regressions                                                      | Tests multi-cell `</td>` isolation, sibling `##` headings, wrapped-reference continuation lines, and multi-ticket compliance bullets.                                                                                                                                |
